***EIP-7979 Should be included in Hegotá.***

* [EIP-8173: Foundations of EVM Control Flow](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8173)
A brief tutorial on the VM and ZK fundamentals underlying these proposals.  Recommended reading.
* [EIP-7979: Call and Return Opcodes for the EVM](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7979)
Subroutines are an essential facility for all Turing-complete blockchain smart contracts.
* [EIP-8337: Validated EVM Code](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8337)
Static control flow is a prerequisite for analyzable blockchain smart contracts.

I have provided full specifications at [EELS, EIP-7979](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3575) and [EELS, EIP-8337](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/3576).

I have prototyped and tested EIP-7979 on two compilers and two interpreters.   By lines of code it is not a large change.
| Implementation | Added | Code | Comments | Removed | Tests |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| [Solidity](https://github.com/argotorg/solidity/pull/17005) | 153 | 129 | 24 | 23 | 3 |
| [Vyper](https://github.com/vyperlang/vyper/pull/5266) | 132 | 108 | 24 | 26 | 0 |
| [geth](https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/compare/master...gcolvin:go-ethereum:eip-7979) | 217 | 153 | 64 | 0 | 205 |
| [evmone](https://github.com/ipsilon/evmone/pull/1706) | 93 | 75 | 18 | 13 | 211 |
| **Total** | **595** | **465** | **130** | **62** | **419** |

Neither is it a complex change, scoring at most 13 ([Preliminary Complexity Assessments for EIP-7979](github.com/ethspecs/pm/issues/72#issuecomment-5646584927)) versus FOCIL at 15 and Frame Transactions at 38 ). Among execution-layer feature EIPs proposed for Hegotá, this is the smallest surface: three constant-gas opcodes and one frame-local stack, with no transaction, block, or gas-accounting component.

Only clients need to make any immediate changes.  Compilers and other tools can adopt this EIP on their own schedule.  EIP-8337 could also be included in this fork, but probably belongs in a later fork, after we have gained more experience with EIP-7979.  My prototype implementations of EIP-7979 generate EIP-8337 compliant code.

***EIP-7979 Should be included in Hegotá.***

Re: [EIP-8163](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8163) "Reserve `EXTENSION (0xae)` opcode"

ACD asked for feedback from L2s and Alt-L1s to voice support for this it before considering it. Offchain definitely supports including this EIP. One reason we don't currently consider adding opcodes to Arbitrum Nitro is that such a reserved opcode doesn't exist.
